events.title: Steam Demo update, v0.3.5:
events.summary: Added:- You can now send send bug reports from the main menu or pause menu — logs and your save file are attached automatically.- Crashes are now reported automatically.Changed:- Pistol and SMG fire visible bullets instead of instant hits. Should help with understanding how accurate these weapons actually are- Keyboard movement defaults to Modern controls; Tank is still available in Settings.- Removed doors and gates that can't be opened in the demo.- footsteps are quieter and vary more in pitch

events.title: Steam Demo
events.summary: Our new demo is ready for Steam release.Some of the changes compared to the first playtest demo: Proper save system immune to save scumming tacticsReduced number of locations and streamlined layoutOver the shoulder camera can now be activated manuallyImproved flow of the camera and less drastic camera changes. Modern controls are much more suitable now.Enemies that appeared from thin air now have proper spawn animationsNew consumable itemsWeapon upgrade systemOption to acquire friendly npc chara

events.title: Development Update
events.summary: Hello everyone.We had to move the release date a few months into next year. The good news is that we can finally afford to work on this full time so we managed to overcome our greatest hurdle that was halting our work all this time. Hopefully we will be able to deliver something tangible soon.No promises but we aim for a solid demo somewhere around the New Year and a full release before May 2026.Thank you all for your patience and support!
